schema.title: JSON schema for SchemaStore.org catalog files

description:
The current schema catalog, referenced from https://json.schemastore.org/schema-catalog.json, is at version 1. It lists three distinct JSON schemas that can be used to validate common configuration files.

The first entry, **Package.json**, is described as “Schema for npm package.json files”. Its schema lives at https://json.schemastore.org/package.json and applies to files matching the pattern `package.json`. The second entry, **GitHub Workflow**, provides a schema for GitHub Actions workflow files, located at https://json.schemastore.org/github-workflow.json. It is relevant for any files matching `.github/workflows/*.yml` or `.github/workflows/*.yaml`. This entry also defines two versioned schemas: version v1 points to https://json.schemastore.org/github-workflow-v1.json and version v2 points to https://json.schemastore.org/github-workflow-v2.json. The third entry, **VS Code Settings**, offers a schema for Visual Studio Code’s settings.json files. Its schema URL is https://json.schemastore.org/vscode-settings.json and it targets files named `settings.json`.
